paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across values.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores for two methods, MatDetector (ours) and ChemDataExtractor, across varying lambda ($\lambda$) values. The x-axis is labeled "$\lambda$ value" and displays a non-linear categorical sequence starting with "w/o", followed by increments of 0.1 from "0.1" to "1", and concluding with "2" and "3". The y-axis represents the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" on a linear scale, with tick marks ranging from 72.0 to 75.5 at regular intervals of 0.5. The line representing "MatDetector (ours)" is depicted as a solid pink line with circular markers. It begins at a score of approximately 72.6 at the "w/o" mark, experiences a local peak of 73.5 at "0.3", and after several fluctuations, reaches its highest peak of approximately 75.6 at an x-axis value of "1", before declining sharply to end at roughly 72.4 at "3". The line representing "ChemDataExtractor" is shown as a dashed dark blue line with square markers. It starts at approximately 72.6 at "w/o", exhibits a local peak of 73.4 at "0.5", and gradually rises to reach its highest point of roughly 73.7 at "1", after which it steadily decreases to conclude at its lowest point of approximately 71.9 at the final x-axis value of "3".
